# Nisar Ali

> Nisar Ali is a Technical Project Manager and Solutions Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan. He currently works at Conxept Innovations (since May 2026), coordinating delivery of web development, SEO, paid media, compliance-sensitive content and marketing automation for 14+ US healthcare clients, mainly psychiatry and TMS therapy clinics.

Nisar combines project management with hands-on technical skills. He leads distributed design, development, content and PPC teams on US Eastern hours, and builds GoHighLevel CRM and automation workflows, n8n and Python automations, WordPress sites and React / Node.js applications.
